settings.text:
Founded in 2005, Qawach crafts and exports premium leather jackets built to last a lifetime.
Using only handpicked full-grain and top-grain leathers—known for strength, comfort, and a rich aging patina—we focus on timeless designs over passing trends. Every jacket is carefully stitched to outlast fast fashion, blending rugged classics with modern versatility. For those who expect more from their wardrobe, Qawach jackets are lifelong investments, designed to gain character and carry stories through generations. Discover bold style, expert craftsmanship, and leather made for everyday life.

settings.description:
The Start of Something Real


We began our journey with a simple goal — to create good-quality leather products and share them with the world. Starting with exports, we focused on making durable, well-crafted leather goods for international clients. In those early years, we had the chance to work on leather jackets for Scott and also supplied exclusive pieces to Tommy Hilfiger.

Stepping Into the Spotlight

Our work started getting noticed. One of our jacket designs made it to the big screen in Dhoom 2, through a project with Pepe Jeans. We also started working with Sweden’s Hunky Dori and created custom leather products for G-III, a well-known name in the global fashion space.

Taking Our Craft Online


We decided to go digital and launched our first online listings on eBay. This was a big step — allowing people from across the globe to directly buy from us and experience what we’ve been making for years.

Hello, Amazon


The next year, we expanded further by launching our products on Amazon, making it even easier for customers to find us, trust us, and shop with confidence.

Consistent & Reliable

Since then, we’ve stayed focused on what we do best — making leather goods that look good, feel right, and last long. Our experience in both manufacturing and online selling helps us stay consistent, reliable, and always improving.

settings.description: For nearly two decades, we've been perfecting the art of leather craftsmanship. Our journey reflects our dedication to quality, tradition, and innovation.
